backend.reason: Excel file processing library. No fix available (npm版は非推奨)。Prototype Pollution (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6) and ReDoS (GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9) vulnerabilities. Mitigated by server-side input validation and trusted file sources only. 2026-06-02 再評価: 依存ツリーに現存・fixAvailable=false を確認し延長。
